newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday, February 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday, February 21.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Preliminary CPI data from six sample cities on Thursday pointed to a year-on-year inflation rate of 2.2 to 2.3 percent and a flat monthly rate. Five further sample cities publish preliminary data on Friday (all).
* Prime Minister Romano Prodi welcomed CPI data saying the figures showed the country was succeeding in cleaning up its finances for EMU and it would be "unpardonable" to stop now (all).
* In a speech to the former communist democratic party congress, Deputy Prime Minister Walter Veltroni said it would be "extremely grave and irresponsible" not to pass a mini-budget (all).

* Italian debt markets ended with healthy gains ahead of first batch of preliminary February CPI data and strengthened their gains after the figures were published. Lira back from brink, near central ERM parity vs mark of 990, also stronger upon CPI data (all).
* Mondadori board meeting named Maurizio Costa as general director of the group, the company still has to name a new managing director. Meanwhile stocks rose 1.6 percent (all).

* Negotiations are underway between trade unions and bank employers to start after Bank of Italy Governar Antonio Fazio in a letter launched a warning over excessive labour costs in th Italian banking system (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
